name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard Mutual NDA, covering confidentiality obligations and exceptions between two parties evaluating a business relationship. Consists of Standard Terms incorporated by reference into a signed Cover Page.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Cover Page
description: Cover Page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA. Captures the deal-specific terms (purpose, effective date, term, confidentiality period) that incorporate the Standard Terms by reference to complete an executed MNDA.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) for SaaS/cloud providers, covering service access and use, support, restrictions, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability, and termination.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard Design Partner Agreement, governing early access to a product in exchange for structured customer feedback during a design partner program.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard Service Level Agreement (SLA), defining uptime targets, support response times, availability calculations, and service credit remedies for cloud service outages.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard Professional Services Agreement (PSA), covering statements of work, deliverables, acceptance, change orders, intellectual property assignment, and subcontractor obligations.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard Data Processing Agreement (DPA), addressing processor/subprocessor relationships, processing instructions, security safeguards, and data subject rights under data protection law.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard Software License Agreement, covering on-premises/installed software licensing, permitted use, open source components, updates, restrictions, and reservation of rights.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard Partnership Agreement, covering mutual obligations, fees, trademark licensing, and cooperation terms between business partners.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA), addressing HIPAA-compliant handling of Protected Health Information (PHI) between a covered entity and a business associate.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard Pilot Agreement, governing time-limited evaluation access to a product ahead of a full commercial engagement, including license scope, restrictions, and termination.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper's standard AI Addendum, supplementing a base agreement with terms specific to AI services, including input/output ownership, model training restrictions, and AI-related disclaimers.
